Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Female, older than 35 years

right.raw_text: Already have mammography, [OR]  or other standard exams (ultrasound, [OR]  MRI, etc)

left.raw_text: Could participate this trial within 2 weeks after mammography

right.raw_text: Have the ability of consent inform

left.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  During pregnancy  [OR] or lactation period

right.raw_text: Patients that may not be capable of prone position, such as patients with scapulohumeral periarthritis, [OR]  cardiac pacemaker  [OR] or have recent cardiac surgery
